description: This file defines a C++ utility for enumerating over ranges, similar to Python's enumerate(), including classes for iterator proxy and range enumeration, with support for const correctness and portability across platforms.

classes.name: Enumerator
classes.description: Iterator class that pairs an iterator with its index, providing dereference and increment operations.

classes.name: RangeEnumerator
classes.description: Wraps a range to provide begin() and end() methods returning Enumerator objects.

methods.name: enumerate
methods.description: Function template that creates a RangeEnumerator for a given range.
